metadata.rho_R_correlations: IPW-weighted Spearman conditional on observed rho_R only; no censoring-adjusted population correlation is claimed
metadata.eligibility_specificity_control: IPW-weighted Spearman conditional on observed O2O events whose first divergence is eligibility
metadata.endpoint_conditioning: endpoint and return-transition summaries condition on an exact replay state being available at the prespecified radius; no interpolation is used
metadata.event_censor_tie_rule: events are processed before censoring at the same recorded radius
